【保存推奨】周年記念パーティー、記憶に残る演出と進行の完全ガイド🎉

「周年記念パーティーの企画を任されたけど、何をどの順番でプログラムに組み込めばいい…」
「参加者が記憶に残るような演出は、どうすれば実現できる…」

人事・総務の担当者さんからよくお聞きするお悩みです。

周年記念パーティーは、目的を明確にするところから始まります。

最初にやるべきこと：「目的の明確化」

📌 周年記念パーティーの4つの主な目的

✔ これまでの歩みを振り返り、共通の誇りと一体感を醸成
✔ 取引先・パートナー企業への感謝を伝える
✔ 経営陣から次フェーズへのビジョンを発信
✔ 社員のモチベーション向上・帰属意識を高める

どの目的に比重を置くかで、プログラム全体が変わります。まずターゲットを絞り込み、それをベースにプログラムを設計することが出発点です。

基本的な進行の流れ（テンプレート）

① 開会・代表挨拶（5～10分）感謝と展望を語る
② セレモニー演出 鏡開き・記念鐘打鐘など象徴的な儀式
③ 乾杯 社内重鎮や来賓が発声
④ 食事・歓談タイム BGM・レイアウトでコミュニケーション活性化
⑤ 余興・エンターテインメント 映像・クイズ・パフォーマンスなど
⑥ 表彰・記念品贈呈 長期勤続者・功績社員を称える
⑦ 締めの挨拶・万歳三唱 会に区切りをつける

参加者の心に残る6つの演出アイデア

① オープニング映像・周年記念ムービー上映
創業からのヒストリー映像や社員インタビューを編集したムービー。パーティー全体の感情的盛り上がりをつくる最も重要な演出です。

② 代表からのメッセージ（手紙の朗読）
経営トップが感謝を自分の言葉で語る。その後に社員から花束を贈る逆サプライズで感動的クライマックスに。

③ 会場演出（空間デザイン・照明・映像投影）
節目の数字・企業ロゴを大型スクリーンに映し出す、ブランドカラーで空間統一。非日常感が生まれます。

④ 社員参加型コンテンツ（クイズ・ゲーム）
会社の歴史にまつわるクイズ、部署対抗ゲーム、カジノパーティ形式。職位・部署を越えたコミュニケーション促進。

⑤ パフォーマンスショー・エンターテインメント
マジックショー、ジャズコンサート、プロダンスパフォーマンス。華やかさと非日常感、モチベーション向上につながります。

⑥ 記念撮影コーナー設置
フォトブース・プロカメラマン、企業ロゴ入り横断幕など。撮影後の共有でパーティー後も余韻が続きます。

周年記念パーティー準備の8つのチェックポイント

✓ 開催日時・会場の確保（早めが最優先）
✓ 参加人数の確認と招待状発送
✓ ケータリング・料理の手配（アレルギー対応）
✓ 映像・コンテンツ制作（制作期間を逆算）
✓ セレモニー用品・装飾物の準備
✓ 運営スタッフ・カメラマンの手配
✓ 進行台本・式次第の作成とリハーサル
✓ 社外ゲスト招待時のプログラム配慮

社外ゲストを招く場合に気をつけたいこと

🎯 やるべきこと
✔ フォーマルな挨拶・来賓紹介・乾杯をしっかり設定
✔ 歓談タイムに担当者がテーブルを回り、直接コミュニケーション
✔ 企業の歴史・事業説明を簡潔に盛り込む
✔ 社員向けの余興・表彰は時間配分に注意

🎯 避けるべきこと
✗ 社内用語を多用、内輪向け演出が長すぎる
✗ 社外ゲストの参加時間を考慮しないプログラム

成功のカギは「細部へのこだわり」と「準備の徹底」

節目を祝う周年記念パーティーだからこそ、細部にこだわった演出と丁寧な準備が、参加者全員にとって特別な思い出をつくります。

「初めての周年でどこから手をつければいいか…」
「社内では準備が追い付かない、企画から運営まで任せたい」

そういった場合も、お気軽にご相談ください。
オージャストは、会場選定から映像制作・セレモニー演出・当日の進行管理まで、一貫してサポートいたします。

貴社の節目を、参加者全員の記憶に残る特別な場にするお手伝いをさせていただきます。

【Recommended to Save】Anniversary Party: Complete Guide to Memorable Direction and Program Flow 🎉

“I’ve been put in charge of planning the anniversary party, but what should I include in the program and in what order…?”
“How can I achieve a direction that participants will remember…?”

These are concerns we often hear from HR and General Affairs staff.

An anniversary party begins with clarifying its purpose.

First Step: “Clarify the Purpose”

📌 Four Main Purposes of an Anniversary Party

✔ Look back on the company’s journey and foster shared pride and unity
✔ Express gratitude to business partners and client companies
✔ Communicate management’s vision for the next phase
✔ Boost employee motivation and strengthen their sense of belonging

The entire program changes depending on which purpose is prioritized. The starting point is to first narrow down the target and then design the program based on that.

Basic Program Flow (Template)

① Opening & Representative Address (5-10 minutes): Express gratitude and outlook
② Ceremony Direction: Symbolic rituals such as kagami-biraki (ceremonial barrel breaking) and commemorative bell ringing
③ Toast: Delivered by senior company members or guests
④ Dining & Socializing Time: Use BGM and layout to activate communication
⑤ Entertainment & Activities: Videos, quizzes, performances, etc.
⑥ Awards & Commemorative Gifts: Honor long-serving employees and those with outstanding achievements
⑦ Closing Address & Banzai Cheers: Conclude the event

Six Direction Ideas to Leave a Lasting Impression on Participants

① Opening Video / Anniversary Movie Screening
A video that compiles the company’s history from its founding and employee interviews. This is the most important element for creating an emotional uplift throughout the party.

② Message from the Representative (Reading a Letter)
Top management expresses gratitude in their own words. Follow this with a surprise reverse presentation of a bouquet from employees for an emotional climax.

③ Venue Direction (Space Design, Lighting, Video Projection)
Project milestone numbers and the company logo onto large screens, and unify the space with brand colors. This creates a sense of the extraordinary.

④ Employee Participation Content (Quizzes, Games)
Company history quizzes, department-vs-department games, casino party formats. Promotes communication across positions and departments.

⑤ Performance Show & Entertainment
Magic shows, jazz concerts, professional dance performances. Adds glamour and a sense of the extraordinary, and boosts motivation.

⑥ Commemorative Photo Corner
Photo booth with professional photographer, banners with the company logo, etc. Sharing photos after the event prolongs the afterglow.

Eight Checkpoints for Anniversary Party Preparation

✓ Secure the date, time, and venue (priority to early booking)
✓ Confirm the number of participants and send invitations
✓ Arrange catering and food (accommodate allergies)
✓ Produce videos and content (calculate production time backwards)
✓ Prepare ceremonial items and decorations
✓ Arrange operations staff and photographer
✓ Create the script and program schedule, and conduct rehearsals
✓ Consider the program when inviting external guests

Things to Keep in Mind When Inviting External Guests

🎯 Things to Do
✔ Firmly set formal greetings, guest introductions, and the toast
✔ Have assigned staff visit tables during socializing time for direct communication
✔ Concisely include the company’s history and business overview
✔ Pay attention to time allocation for employee-oriented entertainment and awards

🎯 Things to Avoid
✗ Overusing internal jargon or making in-group direction too long
✗ Programs that do not consider the participation time of external guests

The Key to Success: “Attention to Detail” and “Thorough Preparation”

Precisely because it is an anniversary party celebrating a milestone, meticulous direction and careful preparation create special memories for all participants.

“It’s my first anniversary and I don’t know where to start…”

If you have such concerns, please feel free to consult us.
Orgiast supports you consistently, from venue selection to video production, ceremony direction, and on-site event management.

We are here to help make your company’s milestone a special occasion that all participants will remember.

キックオフミーティングの進め方と盛り上げる工夫を
10スライドでご紹介

▼ スライド1：盛り上げのコツを体系化

▼ スライド2：目的を明確にする【最重要】
代表的な4つの目的
① 経営方針・目標の全社共有
② チームの一体感・連帯感の醸成
③ 社員のモチベーション向上
④ 新プロジェクトの社内外への宣言

「最も伝えたいこと」を1つ絞る
→ プログラム全体に一貫性が生まれる

▼ スライド3：事前準備①開催形式・会場選定
開催2～3か月前から逆算

【開催形式】
リアル開催＝一体感・熱量重視
オンライン＝全国散在対応
ハイブリッド＝温度差に注意

【会場選択】
普段の会議室より非日常感のある会場
→ 気持ちの切り替え促進
→ 記憶に残りやすい

▼ スライド4：事前準備②プログラム設計
「情報インプット」と「参加型」のバランスが鍵

60～90分に1回は参加者が動けるコーナーを挿入
ワーク・対話・投票で緊張感を維持

【半日4時間プログラムの例】
オープニング映像（5-10分）

プログラム表を関係者間で共有
→ 準備の抜け漏れを防止

▼ スライド5：オープニング演出【最初が勝負】
① 映像・動画の活用
 ビジョンをビジュアル表現
 ハイライト動画で感情共感

② MCやファシリテーター
 テンポコントロールが重要
 プロに依頼も効果的

③ 入場前から演出
 ウェルカムボード
 席のギフト・メッセージ
 特別なBGM

「この場は特別」と感じさせる工夫

① チームビルディングワーク
 部署・職種が異なるグループで対話

 普段接点がない社員がフラットに関われる

② リアルタイム投票・アンケート
 スマートフォン・タブレット活用
 投票結果を即座に表示
 → 会場全体が盛り上がる

▼ スライド7：盛り上がるコンテンツ②表彰・懇親
③ 表彰式の工夫
 受賞者のエピソード・苦労話を動画化
 同僚からのコメント映像を放映
 感動が会場全体に広がる

④ 懇親会・交流タイム
 立食スタイルで動きやすく
 テーブルにゲーム・クイズを配置
 「テーマトーク席」を設定
 自然と会話が生まれる仕掛け

▼ スライド8：オンライン・ハイブリッド開催での工夫
課題：オンライン参加者が傍観者になりやすい

工夫①チャット・リアクション機能を活用
進行役が声かけで場の一部として関わる

工夫②ブレイクアウトルーム
5～6名の小グループで発言しやすく

工夫③共通体験の演出
バーチャル背景の統一・カメラON・リアクション

工夫④映像・音声品質への投資
カメラアングル・照明の調整
事前テストで当日トラブル防止

▼ スライド9：フォローアップと振り返り【決め手】
① ハイライト映像を翌日までに社内配信
 参加者の余韻を持続

490a3d01f5ee22f356bed9e5cb8efda4e1b9edae.en:
Are you truly energizing your kickoff meeting?

"We just read out the policy and it ended..."
"The participants' expressions were stiff..."

We introduce how to conduct a kickoff meeting and ways to energize it in 10 slides.

▼ Slide 1: Systematize the tips for energizing

▼ Slide 2: Clarify the purpose [Most Important]
4 typical purposes:
1. Company-wide sharing of management policy and goals
2. Fostering team unity and a sense of solidarity
3. Improving employee motivation
4. Announcing a new project both internally and externally

Narrow down to "the most important thing to convey"
→ Creates consistency throughout the program

▼ Slide 3: Advance preparation ① Format selection and venue selection
Work backwards from 2 to 3 months before the event

[Event format]
In-person event = Focus on unity and energy
Online = For employees scattered nationwide
Hybrid = Beware of differences in engagement levels

[Venue selection]
Choose a venue with a more extraordinary atmosphere than a typical meeting room
→ Promotes a mental shift
→ Easy to remember

▼ Slide 4: Advance preparation ② Program design
Balance between "information input" and "participation" is key

Insert a segment where participants can move around once every 60 to 90 minutes
Maintain a sense of engagement through workshops, dialogue, and voting

[Example of a half-day 4-hour program]
Opening video (5-10 min)
Management message (20-30 min)
Departmental initiative sharing (20-30 min)
Awards ceremony (15-20 min)
Group work (30-45 min)
Closing (10-15 min)
Social gathering (60 min~)

Share the program table with relevant parties
→ Prevents omissions in preparation

▼ Slide 5: Opening production [The first impression is crucial]
1. Use of images and videos
  Visual representation of the vision
  Emotional engagement through highlight videos

2. MC or facilitator
  Tempo control is important
  Hiring a professional can also be effective

3. Production even before entry
  Welcome board
  Gifts or messages at seats
  Special BGM

Ways to make participants feel "This place is special"

▼ Slide 6: Engaging content ① Participation type
1. Team building workshop
  Dialogue in groups with different departments and roles
  Questions like "What are the important values for this term?"
  Allows employees who usually have no contact to interact on a level playing field

2. Real-time voting and surveys
  Use smartphones and tablets
  Display voting results immediately
  → Excites the entire venue

▼ Slide 7: Engaging content ② Awards and socializing
3. Creative awards ceremony
  Video the recipients' stories and struggles
  Show video comments from colleagues
  Emotion spreads throughout the venue

4. Social gathering / networking time
  Buffet style for easy movement
  Place games and quizzes on tables
  Set up "theme talk seats"
  Mechanisms that naturally generate conversation

▼ Slide 8: Tips for online and hybrid events
Challenge: Online participants tend to become bystanders

Tip 1: Utilize chat and reaction functions
  The facilitator engages them by calling out, making them part of the event

Tip 2: Breakout rooms
  Small groups of 5-6 people make it easier to speak up

Tip 3: Create shared experiences
  Unified virtual backgrounds, cameras ON, reactions

Tip 4: Invest in video and audio quality
  Adjust camera angles and lighting
  Conduct advance tests to prevent issues on the day

▼ Slide 9: Follow-up and review [The Deciding Factor]
1. Distribute highlight videos internally by the next day
  Maintain the participants' lingering excitement
  Also convey the content to absent employees

2. Survey participants
  "What left an impression on you?"
  "What would you like to see improved next time?"
  → Visualizes improvements for the next kickoff

3. Regular review in daily operations
  Review the policy in weekly and monthly meetings
  Repeatedly refer to the kickoff content
  Leads to changes in employee behavior and awareness

▼ Slide 10: 7 Points for Success
✅ Clear purpose
✅ Thorough advance preparation
✅ Opening production
✅ Participatory content
✅ Engagement design
✅ Online support
✅ Follow-up system

Solve your internal event planning concerns with a checklist!

"Problems were discovered on the day itself..."
"I still have concerns about the preparations..."
"I don't know where to start..."

For those in charge with such concerns,
we introduce a 5-phase checklist covering everything from planning to post-event follow-up.

▼ 1: Eliminate preparation anxiety
Prevent omissions with the checklist

▼ 2: Planning Phase
1. Clarify the purpose and goal
  The first step determines quality

2. Determine the target audience and scale
  Decide on the participants and expected number of attendees

3. Select the event format
  Choose from in-person, online, or hybrid

4. Formulate a budget plan
  Identifying expense items and securing a contingency fund are important

5. Set the schedule and assign responsibilities
  Create milestones by working backwards from the event date

▼ 3: Venue and equipment arrangement phase
1. Reserve and contract the venue
  Check capacity, access, and facilities

2. Design the layout
  Choose the seating style (school, theater, banquet)

3. Check audio and video equipment
  Conduct operational tests for microphones, screens, and lighting

4. Arrange food and beverages
  Confirm quantities, allergy accommodations, and serving times

5. Accessibility considerations
  Confirm in advance for wheelchair users and those requiring health-related accommodations

* Venue troubles are often discovered just before the event
  Early confirmation is important!

▼ 4: Attendee recruitment and communication phase
1. Send invitation emails and internal announcements
  Clearly state the date, time, venue, purpose, and items to bring
  Include reminder emails in the plan

2. Manage the participant list
  Track registration status in real time
  Decide in advance how to handle overcapacity or shortfalls

3. Share the day's program
  Distribute the timetable in advance
  Also announce any information requiring preparation beforehand

* Insufficient information sharing leads to lower participation rates

▼ 5: Day-of operation phase
1. Morning setup and equipment check on the day
  Complete 1-2 hours before opening
  Final check of audio, video, and reception environment

2. Brief the staff
  Share assigned areas and emergency contact flow

3. Set up the reception and guidance system
  Clarify name list verification, seating guidance, and baggage handling

4. Assign a timekeeper
  Manage the program to proceed as scheduled

5. Set up a trouble contact point
  Primary contact for equipment issues, health problems, and latecomers

* In preparation for unexpected events,
  scheduling with buffer time is important

▼ 6: Post-event follow-up phase
1. Conduct a survey
  Collect participant feedback promptly
  Design questions aligned with the event's purpose

2. Create a report and minutes
  Summarize event results, budget, number of participants, and outcomes

3. Organize and distribute photos and videos
  Organize and utilize recorded materials from the day

4. Identify areas for improvement
  Based on survey results and reviews
  Document improvement points for the next event

* Handling after the event ends
  leads to quality improvement for the next event

▼ 7: Comprehensive support
"Not sure where to start with preparations"
"Want to run operations without any omissions"
"Limited in-house staff available to handle it"

Orgiast provides end-to-end support for planning, script creation,
day-of operation, and production design

Significantly reducing the burden of preparation

Are your preparations for the online general meeting of shareholders going smoothly?

📊 We introduce "8 Key Points for Success" for online general meetings of shareholders.

▼ Do you have these concerns?
・Afraid of streaming issues
・Worried that employees will get bored
・Unsure of the day-of operational structure

▼ What you can do online
✓ Employees nationwide can participate, reducing travel costs
✓ Employees with childcare or caregiving responsibilities can participate more easily
✓ Follow up with employees who could not attend via archives

▼ 3 Environmental settings that determine streaming quality
1. Platform selection
  Thoroughly check interactivity and capacity for the number of participants

2. Network stability is the top priority
  Prepare a wired LAN connection plus a mobile line for backup

3. Equipment setup (camera, microphone, lighting)
  The quality of built-in computer equipment is limited

▼ Program design that captivates viewers
・Create impact with an opening video
・Keep sessions to around 20-30 minutes
・Ensure interactivity with real-time polls, games, and quizzes
・Insert interactive elements throughout

▼ Video production for awards ceremonies and presentation sessions
・Create a visually cohesive space using chroma key compositing
・Emphasize award moments with captions, BGM, and lighting
・Thoroughly capture recipients' reactions on camera
→ There are production techniques possible precisely because it is online

▼ Day-of operational structure [5 essential positions]
1. Streaming operator (manages video and audio switching)
2. MC for program progression (manages program flow and speaker introductions)
3. Chat and Q&A moderator (manages and monitors questions)
4. Technical support specialist (contact point for troubleshooting)
5. Overall director (manages timeline and overall direction)

Clear role division is key to stable operation

▼ Considerations for new employees and remote employees
・Incorporate a new employee introduction session
・Offer forms of participation beyond just speaking
 (Chat reactions, survey responses, etc.)
・Always finish on time to create an environment where people feel free to leave without hesitation

Improving participant engagement
comes from careful attention to detail

▼ Reduce preparation work with comprehensive support
Orgiast provides comprehensive support for video production, streaming operations, and program design

We support participation from across the country
and help improve employee engagement
by leveraging the remote work environment

スマートフォンで投票した結果が

▼ スライド3：3つのメリット

② 経営層と現場のギャップを可視化

"Participants are somehow passive..."

Solve that problem with real-time voting.

Participants transform from "audience" to "stakeholders."
A 10-slide guide to improving internal events.

▼ Slides 1-2: What is real-time voting?

A system where results of votes cast via smartphone
appear on screen within tens of seconds.

Differences from traditional paper surveys
・All participants share results instantly
・Data is accumulated automatically
・Accessible via QR code
・Hybrid support available

▼ Slide 3: Three benefits

① Encourages active participation
"My answers are reflected in the results"
→ Improves concentration during passive events

② Visualizes gaps between management and the front line
"Comprehension is at 50%..."
→ Everyone shares awareness on the spot

③ Data utilization after the event
→ Basis for improvement next time
→ Easy analysis with CSV export

▼ Slide 4: Use in general shareholders' meetings

Transform presentations into two-way dialogue

・Before presentation: Vote on "What is the most critical issue?"
・After presentation: Confirm "Do you agree?"
・Streamline Q&A with voting

▼ Slide 5: Use in kick-off meetings

Foster team cohesion

・Share "What is your biggest concern?"
・Create keywords with a word cloud
・Compete for points with quizzes

▼ Slide 6: Use in award ceremonies

Create a production that involves all participants

・Vote on "Most memorable project"
・Generate a sense of participation with additional awards
・Visualize support messages

▼ Slide 7: 5 points for tool selection

① Ease of use (QR code + browser-based)
② Network environment (Check Wi-Fi capacity)
③ Question types (multiple choice, free text, etc.)
④ Anonymity settings
⑤ Post-event analysis functions (CSV/PDF export)

▼ Slide 8: Common failures and countermeasures

・Network issues → Pre-test, backup router
・Mismatch with event flow → Specify in script
・Too many votes → Limit to 3-5 rounds
・Results shown without comment → Speaker provides commentary

▼ Slide 9: Measuring effectiveness

4 perspectives to measure
・Voter turnout
・Improvement in satisfaction surveys
・Grasp of comprehension and empathy levels
・Value of data utilization

Clarify "what to measure" before introduction

▼ Slide 10: Summary and CTA

Transforming events from "just watching" to "participating"

4 keys to successful implementation
① Pre-check network environment
② Incorporate into the script
③ Limit the number of questions
④ Create dialogue by commenting on results

Use cases
・General shareholders' meeting → Two-way sharing of management policy
・Kick-off meeting → Team building
・Award ceremony → Participatory production

▼ スライド1：懇親会とは
参加者同士が互いをよく知る
親しい関係を築くことが主目的

▼ スライド2～3：5つの活用目的

→ 組織全体のつながりを強化

② 経営理念・方針の浸透
社員総会・キックオフ後に
経営層と現場社員の直接対話
→ 理念が「体験」として浸透

③ 部門間連携の促進
組織再編やプロジェクト立ち上げ時に
サイロ化（情報の分断）を解消

④ 新入社員・中途入社者の定着支援
複数の先輩・上司との接点
心理的障壁を設計で取り除く

⑤ 表彰・成果の共有
受賞者を身近に感じられる場
モチベーションが伝播

▼ スライド4：形式による違い

着席型（ディナー形式）
✓ 深い会話が生まれやすい

立食型（ビュッフェ形式）
✓ 多くの人と短時間で交流
✗ 場が散漫になりやすい

目的と参加人数で選び分ける

▼ スライド5～6：運営の実務ポイント

① 司会・ファシリテーターの役割を明確に

事前に関係者で共有

ゲーム・クイズ・自己紹介タイムで
共通点を見つけやすく

テーブルごとにテーマ設定
ネームカードに所属部署を明記

ノンアルコール飲料を十分に用意

▼ スライド7：オンライン・ハイブリッド対応と
　　　　　　　メインイベントとの組み合わせ

・ブレイクアウトルームで少人数交流
・画面越しでも参加できるゲーム企画
・オンライン参加者の疎外感を取り除く

社員総会・キックオフ・表彰式との連携

キックオフ後なら
新年度方針を話題の軸に
経営層が各テーブルを回る

表彰式後なら
受賞者が会場を歩き回れるように
他の参加者が声をかけやすい雰囲気づくり

▼ スライド8：効果測定と改善サイクル

✓「新たな人と話せたか」

✓「次回参加したいか」

行動・意識に関わる項目が
改善のヒントになる

その他の重要指標

・自由記述の意見
・年度ごとの比較

記録を残し継続的に改善
→ 懇親会の質は継続的に高まる

▼ スライド9：成功の鍵となる

メインイベントの所要時間や

バランスある設計が成功のカギ

54ea3fb3b616c926dc9279d598f4a6e36bdd8b33.en:
"A reception is just a drinking party?"

No, it is a strategic management tool.

To those in charge of HR, General Affairs, and Corporate Planning,
we thoroughly explain the essence and usage of receptions
in 10 slides.

▼ Slide 1: What is a reception?
The main purpose is for participants to get to know each other
and build close relationships.

Its feature is that the format, content, and target audience
can be flexibly designed according to the objective.

▼ Slides 2-3: 5 usage objectives

① Improve engagement
Create cross-departmental opportunities for interaction
with employees you rarely meet.
→ Strengthen connections across the organization

② Disseminate management philosophy and policies
Direct dialogue between management and front-line employees
after general shareholders' meetings or kick-offs.
→ The philosophy permeates as an "experience"

③ Promote inter-departmental collaboration
Eliminate silos during organizational restructuring or project launches.

④ Support retention of new and mid-career hires
Create opportunities for contact with multiple senior colleagues and supervisors.
Remove psychological barriers through design.

⑤ Share awards and achievements
A setting where award winners are seen as approachable.
Motivation spreads.

▼ Slide 4: Differences by format

Seated (Dinner format)
✓ Deep conversations are more likely
✗ Difficult to talk to people other than your fixed partner

Standing (Buffet format)
✓ Interact with many people in a short time
✗ The atmosphere can become disjointed

Choose based on the objective and number of participants.

▼ Slides 5-6: Practical operational points

① Clarify the roles of the emcee and facilitator
Include time allocation, responsible person, and cues in the script.
Share with relevant parties beforehand.

② Incorporate icebreakers
Solve the initial "Who do I talk to...?" problem.
Use games, quizzes, and self-introduction time
to make it easier to find common ground.

③ Design seating and layout strategically
Use assigned seating to prevent same-department clusters.
Set themes for each table.
Include department names on name tags.

④ Don't forget beverage choices and considerations
Prepare plenty of non-alcoholic beverages.
Accommodate food allergies and religious dietary restrictions.

▼ Slide 7: Online/Hybrid compatibility and
　　　　　Combination with main events

With the spread of remote work...
・Small group interaction in breakout rooms
・Game plans that even participants on screens can join
・Eliminate the sense of isolation for online participants

Coordination with general meetings, kick-offs, and award ceremonies

After a kick-off:
Use the new annual policy as a conversation topic.
Management circulates among tables.

After an award ceremony:
Allow winners to walk around the venue.
Create an atmosphere where other participants feel comfortable approaching them.

▼ Slide 8: Measuring effectiveness and the improvement cycle

"It was lively, so it's okay" is not enough.

Items to measure in surveys
✓ Not just satisfaction
✓ "Were you able to talk to new people?"
✓ "Did your feelings about the company/workplace change?"
✓ "Would you like to participate again?"

Items related to behavior and awareness
provide hints for improvement.

Other important metrics
・Participation rate itself
・Free-text comments
・Year-over-year comparisons

Keep records and continuously improve.
→ The quality of receptions will continually increase.

▼ Slide 9: Key to success:
　　　　　　　Overall design

To improve the quality of a reception,
it is essential to carefully design the entire process.

① Clarify the objective
Articulate "what you want to achieve."
Pre-set "what kind of conversations will occur."

② Select the format
Seated or standing?
Decide based on the number of participants and objective.

③ Design the flow
Specify detailed time allocations and responsible persons in the script.
The emcee and speakers coordinate and confirm beforehand.

④ Seating layout
Strategic arrangement according to the objective.
Incorporate mechanisms to promote interaction.

⑤ Measure effectiveness
Verify goal achievement through surveys.
Accumulate data for next improvement.

Balanced design, also considering the main event's duration
and participants' state, is the key to success.

▼ Slide 10: Summary and CTA

Receptions are management tools.

Not just a place for meals and socializing,
they are an important component of corporate events
that can address organizational challenges such as:

✓ Improving engagement
✓ Disseminating philosophy and policies
✓ Promoting inter-departmental collaboration
✓ Supporting new employee retention
✓ Sharing and celebrating achievements

By giving the reception strategic meaning as a person in charge
and carefully designing the entire process,

the overall outcome of the internal event
can be expected to improve significantly.

ffd5f9b13ae91d0e0bc98f1dc970a32a875cd9e9.en: there were business division reports, 29th term initiatives, personnel system reports, promotion certificate announcements, and executive introductions.

caf4aeeefdde909a07e7e4f88c6a933f215a475d.ja: そして、会場が大いに盛り上がったのは、全２４部門の表彰でした。
caf4aeeefdde909a07e7e4f88c6a933f215a475d.en: And what got the venue especially excited was the awards ceremony for all 24 divisions.

5c37fd2c4f11ad1f68a6d4d09b503c3e495a689a.ja: びっくり企画も登場した第３部は、笑顔の絶えない４時間でした。
5c37fd2c4f11ad1f68a6d4d09b503c3e495a689a.en: With surprise plans also making an appearance, Part 3 was four hours filled with non-stop smiles.

73930fb0f983fc696adc4ed179cb8f5d67d9497d.ja: 第３部 決起会は、スクール形式から丸テーブル配置へとレイアウトが変更され、気分一新。
73930fb0f983fc696adc4ed179cb8f5d67d9497d.en: For Part 3, the layout was changed from a schoolroom style to round tables, providing a fresh atmosphere.

52a147d6bf7387bd04707c3e7159737bf6ef2043.ja: 代表挨拶、来賓挨拶、乾杯挨拶に続いては歓談タイムに“お愉しみ”企画が次々と登場しました。
52a147d6bf7387bd04707c3e7159737bf6ef2043.en: Following the representative's greeting, guest greeting, and toast, there was a socializing time where "fun" plans appeared one after another.

98857833a1cba5419b37691e76932f94c678f5d1.ja: 当たり前のことを当たり前にするためにとの狙いのもと、ルールを守れない勤怠者を敢えて表彰するというものですが、しっかりお仕置きもありました。
98857833a1cba5419b37691e76932f94c678f5d1.en: With the aim of ensuring that obvious things are done in an obvious way, this is a program that deliberately recognizes employees who fail to follow the rules, but there was also a proper punishment.

31feab957c4bd0dbafc917b8d07d35ddb81b5db7.ja: ライト綱引き大会は、６チームによる部署対抗戦。決勝を制したチームはさらなる賞金アップを社長に直訴し、社長をリーダーとする幹部チームに圧勝。
31feab957c4bd0dbafc917b8d07d35ddb81b5db7.en: The light tug-of-war tournament was a department-vs-department contest with 6 teams. The team that won the finals directly appealed to the president for a further increase in the prize money and achieved a decisive victory over the executive team led by the president.

b43292d0a2576223c9567c73837ab341ef066a37.ja: 喜びは最高潮に達しました。

2e4bfc061e9d063b1f1462190ac8353fa3c44d4f.ja: 両親や家族から届けられた写真・コメントが巨大スクリーンに映し出されるメッセージムービーは大ヒット。
2e4bfc061e9d063b1f1462190ac8353fa3c44d4f.en: The message movie, which displayed photos and comments sent from parents and family on a giant screen, was a huge hit.

67762e3060c55251d7d9a86c44dd6f5036f8e1f2.ja: QRコードを活用した仕掛ですが、表彰時スクリーンに映し出される参加者からのライブメッセージも受けました
67762e3060c55251d7d9a86c44dd6f5036f8e1f2.en: Although it was a mechanism using QR codes, we also received live messages from participants displayed on the screen during the awards ceremony.

6d6a0916824214935fec590be6471989d58a461c.ja: びっくり企画。頭がスッポリ入る巨大グラスでのビール飲み干しには３名が挑戦。
6d6a0916824214935fec590be6471989d58a461c.en: Surprise plan. Three people took on the challenge of drinking a beer from a giant glass that completely fits over the head.

a695856afddbab6b502a1635518d8f9a7fc26dd7.ja: 会場から“ラブコール”を受けた諸石社長は、ビール＆シャンパン飲み干しにチャレンジされました。
a695856afddbab6b502a1635518d8f9a7fc26dd7.en: President Moroishi, who received a "love call" from the venue, took on the challenge of drinking beer and champagne.

f2a7b22b67b46d378b13da6f5e81ce61ab89c9c2.ja: 社長vsテーブル代表による賞金争奪のじゃんけん対決も、楽しみなイベントとなりました。
f2a7b22b67b46d378b13da6f5e81ce61ab89c9c2.en: The rock-paper-scissors showdown between the president and the table representatives for the prize money also became an anticipated event.

cd4aee5e168ea74024188eaa88b95c6b62f17c13.ja: 賑わいとともに活力あふれる決起会は、笑顔とともに閉幕となりました。
cd4aee5e168ea74024188eaa88b95c6b62f17c13.en: The rally, full of bustle and vitality, came to a close with smiles.

471d45a1cf4476bbfd271dbcc53e3c0b4c4a6833.ja: 4月5日（金）渋谷ストリームにて、株式会社日本ワークス様の社員総会（事業報告会・表彰式）が行われました。
471d45a1cf4476bbfd271dbcc53e3c0b4c4a6833.en: On Friday, April 5th, the General Meeting of Employees (Business Report Meeting and Awards Ceremony) for Nihon Works Co., Ltd. was held at Shibuya Stream.

0bd45c99ffe8a54de32a627bd8c3b407684d3160.ja: 会場内は終始、2名の有名なDJとDJによる音と映像に合わせた演出により華やかなムードに包まれた、楽しい雰囲気で行われました。
0bd45c99ffe8a54de32a627bd8c3b407684d3160.en: Throughout the event, the venue was enveloped in a glamorous mood, with a fun atmosphere created by two famous DJs and a production synchronized with sound and video.

b1cef70ef9bbc30da32e26cf0cd633e9e6e88682.ja: 矢嶋取締役の個性あふれた登場から始まり、これから何か起きるのではないか？と思わせるような開会の挨拶でした。
b1cef70ef9bbc30da32e26cf0cd633e9e6e88682.en: Starting with the personality-filled entrance of Director Yajima, it was an opening address that made one wonder if something was about to happen.

50ad9d0df6f488bbd02e1e3d543bf447cff5d560.ja: 鎌田社長をはじめとする役員の方々は、チーム力向上・会社内部の改革へ注力することを掲げ、未来を楽しくするための社員総会にしたい想いを伝えスタートしました！
50ad9d0df6f488bbd02e1e3d543bf447cff5d560.en: The officers, including President Kamada, declared their focus on improving team strength and internal company reform, and began by conveying their desire to make the General Meeting of Employees one that makes the future enjoyable!

94cfe076edcbd2c01952aed596ca2f1840a5c3ad.ja: 鏡開きが行われ、楽しい雰囲気で歓談が始まりました♪
94cfe076edcbd2c01952aed596ca2f1840a5c3ad.en: A ceremonial barrel breaking (kagami biraki) was held, and socializing began in a fun atmosphere♪

839efddb067c6460e69ed77df485c4ec74b6134a.en: Introduction of New Employees for Fiscal Year 2019!

9b4ada42ad99d3e9d54ae97ff658cc67be265e56.ja: 皆さん、緊張な面持ちで登壇していきましたが、壇上後は覚悟が決まったような面持ちに変わりました。
9b4ada42ad99d3e9d54ae97ff658cc67be265e56.en: Everyone stepped up to the podium with a tense expression, but after taking the stage, their expressions changed to ones of resolve.

8ce3f15de2dfe05885188f5fe5dee53ba0d83f67.ja: 各自が自分自身を表す『漢字一文字』を手に持ちながら、自分自身を思う存分表現していました。きっと、先輩社員の方々へ各自の想いや人物像が伝わり、“これからどんどん活躍するだろう！”と思われたに違いありません。
8ce3f15de2dfe05885188f5fe5dee53ba0d83f67.en: Each person expressed themselves to their heart's content while holding a "single kanji character" that represents themselves. Surely, their thoughts and personalities were conveyed to the senior employees, who must have thought, "They will surely become increasingly active!"

5b71db2885b21e992106be4b72765040ce1cf43e.ja: 職場対抗による『格付けチェック』が行われました。

1685e991d3665093886176e677c1de2a0538938f.ja: 優勝チームへのサプライズプレゼントは、『全員でカラオケ熱唱』！職場の団結力がさらに増しました。
1685e991d3665093886176e677c1de2a0538938f.en: The surprise present for the winning team was a "Passionate Karaoke Singing Session for Everyone"! This further strengthened workplace unity.

f4833dcadabb1dedb1900f2d04364853eb4e63b0.ja: 普段、社内ではなかなか見ることができないであろう各自の姿（人間性）を見ることができ、楽しい時間を過ごしていました。
f4833dcadabb1dedb1900f2d04364853eb4e63b0.en: We were able to see sides of each person (their humanity) that would normally be difficult to see within the company, and everyone had an enjoyable time.

8b83f10c651603a8b87b15841787bc5d6ffdac34.en: The Awards Ceremony Everyone Dreams Of!

bf2dfb4af7056bda22ebaef17282d976a2f646c7.ja: 1部・2部に分かれた表彰式。営業成績のみならず、社内での貢献度や社員の投票による部門など、多岐に渡る部門があり、表彰された方々は喜びに満ちた表情で壇上に上がり表彰されていました。
bf2dfb4af7056bda22ebaef17282d976a2f646c7.en: The awards ceremony was divided into Part 1 and Part 2. There were a wide variety of categories, including not only sales performance but also contributions within the company and categories based on employee votes. Those who were recognized appeared on stage with expressions full of joy and were honored.

4488c45c19a73e8693b989eab2d37d50f9684663.ja: 今回、残念ながら表彰まで至らなかった社員の方々は、壇上での表彰式を見ながら“来年こそは私が！”と言った決意の表情で温かく祝福している様子が印象的でした。
4488c45c19a73e8693b989eab2d37d50f9684663.en: The employees who unfortunately did not receive an award this time watched the ceremony on stage with determined expressions, as if saying, "Next year it will be me!" and their warm congratulations were impressive.

bda3cab8cebb7e4f4d215b4618cf03077ecc5d28.ja: さらに、表彰式のクライマックス『年間個人賞』では、鎌田社長からのサプライズプレゼント付きとなり、受賞者は感無量な面持ちで喜んでいました。
bda3cab8cebb7e4f4d215b4618cf03077ecc5d28.en: Furthermore, the climax of the awards ceremony, the "Annual Individual Award," came with a surprise present from President Kamada, and the recipient was overjoyed with an expression of deep emotion.

46aa0bc3aca3d3d990ca7a532416de3533ff1e82.ja: 鎌田社長から３つの言葉が送られました。

87b892e779f864aa90c63a3820ec40d38f38fb28.ja: ①諦めないで、逃げないで進んだ方が良い！
87b892e779f864aa90c63a3820ec40d38f38fb28.en: ① It's better to move forward without giving up or running away!

45468e1ce1d4ea8257d5f5a33836b2281ef9f9e3.ja: ※2つに分かれる時がある（岐路に立った時）
45468e1ce1d4ea8257d5f5a33836b2281ef9f9e3.en: ※When there is a fork in the road (when at a crossroads)

28a551c563da0bde93665e6329c6201d417a0f4a.ja: ②やらないで後悔するより、やった方が良い！
28a551c563da0bde93665e6329c6201d417a0f4a.en: ② It's better to do something and regret it than not do it and regret it!

97780cc00f77fb3657a2f15db3c0af6b6ccc22c8.en: ③ I want you to uphold justice!

a3305fcd94033b181e8283bb2b863c737517e8e3.ja: 集合写真の際には、今回のテーマ『改革』に向けた、協調性・チームワーク向上に繋がったかと思います。和気あいあいとした雰囲気を感じつつ、各自が総会を通して刺激を受け、各社員の別の一面も知ることができたでしょう。
a3305fcd94033b181e8283bb2b863c737517e8e3.en: During the group photo, I think this contributed to improving coordination and teamwork, aligned with the theme of "Reform." While feeling a harmonious atmosphere, each person likely received inspiration through the general meeting and also learned about another side of each employee.

ec0aab2c93ecc282ffa00ab5868cc38631d279b0.ja: “明日からの仕事に繋がり発展していく！”そんな社員総会となりました。
ec0aab2c93ecc282ffa00ab5868cc38631d279b0.en: This General Meeting of Employees was one that would "connect to and develop tomorrow's work!"

e5d33e961e29acf984349a156b797880d5df94d6.ja: 初夏の雰囲気も感じる晴天の6月3日、株式会社エクストリンク様「第14期経営方針発表会」が開催されました。
e5d33e961e29acf984349a156b797880d5df94d6.en: On June 3rd, a sunny day with a sense of early summer, the Extlink Co., Ltd. "14th Term Management Policy Announcement Meeting" was held.

43a5cd11698b380122c4b13b0d458a6cea25b02b.ja: このイベントは、第一部「第14期経営方針発表会」、第二部「Extlink AWARD」、第三部「決起会」で構成しており、企画・制作・運営・実施をオージャストが任せていただきました！
43a5cd11698b380122c4b13b0d458a6cea25b02b.en: This event consisted of Part 1 "14th Term Management Policy Announcement Meeting," Part 2 "Extlink AWARD," and Part 3 "Rally," and Orgiast was entrusted with the planning, production, operation, and execution!

7168a7676b7e50e330d8468b03bc31498e652f8a.ja: レポーターとしてイベントに参加させていただきましたので、ご紹介します！
7168a7676b7e50e330d8468b03bc31498e652f8a.en: I participated in the event as a reporter, so I will introduce it!

b5daebfa04dedeecf7524c42370cb0d3f092d002.ja: この日は、選抜された社員の皆さんが140人、全国各地から集まってこられました。
b5daebfa04dedeecf7524c42370cb0d3f092d002.en: On this day, 140 selected employees gathered from all over the country.

de209f19c920da2de2d8d0f927dc68d8e49c6876.ja: イベント開始30分前に開場すると、続々と社員の皆さんが受付を済まして会場へ入場されます。
de209f19c920da2de2d8d0f927dc68d8e49c6876.en: When the doors opened 30 minutes before the event started, employees one after another completed registration and entered the venue.

e57237756186ef784dfdce1ee2ee0f9c0bdd3cb8.ja: 久々に顔を合わす方々も多いのか、会場のいたる所で話が盛り上がっている様子でした。
e57237756186ef784dfdce1ee2ee0f9c0bdd3cb8.en: Perhaps because many people were seeing each other for the first time in a while, conversations seemed lively in all parts of the venue.

2c85af44989e2674a53f310721078891d48d2b38.ja: 定刻の少し前にイベントはスタート！まず、エクストリンク様社員の皆さんが普段頑張っておられる様子が動画で流れます。
2c85af44989e2674a53f310721078891d48d2b38.en: The event started shortly before the scheduled time! First, a video was shown of Extlink employees working hard in their daily routines.

a87b70ec36377a1828aeaace7aab7da9fc208680.ja: 業務に取り組む姿、後輩を励ます姿など、日常の風景が流れ、会場が賑やかになります。
a87b70ec36377a1828aeaace7aab7da9fc208680.en: Scenes of daily life, such as engaging in work and encouraging junior colleagues, were shown, and the venue became lively.

da6ebdf716a09bc0db8a6985f5eb9b061a9c2a2a.ja: 動画終了後、社員の皆さんの割れんばかりの大きな拍手の中、廣瀬社長がご登壇されます。
da6ebdf716a09bc0db8a6985f5eb9b061a9c2a2a.en: After the video ended, President Hirose took the stage amidst thunderous applause from the employees.

2aeb58a015edc910d928eff7ce781e03f38f67fa.ja: 「お疲れ様！」という廣瀬社長のご挨拶からプレゼンが始まりました。
2aeb58a015edc910d928eff7ce781e03f38f67fa.en: The presentation began with President Hirose's greeting, "Good work!"

43c481b6ac0542816b3dec1f4e546ce6a0010caa.ja: 前期の振り返り、今期の方針・目標などについて熱く語る社長の声に、真剣に耳を傾ける社員の皆さん。
43c481b6ac0542816b3dec1f4e546ce6a0010caa.en: Employees listened intently to the president's passionate voice as he spoke about the previous term's review, this term's policies, and goals.

ccb8c2caf09afab401ef86eff3a2a857e67f043a.ja: 引き締まった空気の会場が印象的です。
ccb8c2caf09afab401ef86eff3a2a857e67f043a.en: The tense atmosphere of the venue was impressive.

c00b8215dc5f7b20b78455f6869693f7ed3c312b.ja: 廣瀬社長に続いて、モバイルソリューション営業統括　吉澤様、法人事業統括本部執行役員　石岡様より、それぞれ事業部別発表がありました。
c00b8215dc5f7b20b78455f6869693f7ed3c312b.en: Following President Hirose, Mobile Solutions Sales Supervisor Yoshizawa and Executive Officer of the Corporate Business Headquarters General Manager Ishioka each gave their respective divisional presentations.

7f4d5fd8ba5bbd7938621758ab7bc71d0310da83.ja: 事業部別発表でも、社員の皆さんに対する力強いメッセージがあり、社員の皆さんは大きな拍手で応えます。
7f4d5fd8ba5bbd7938621758ab7bc71d0310da83.en: The divisional presentations also contained powerful messages directed at the employees, and the employees responded with enthusiastic applause.

2d605116cdcce253c032bdb76151de00e5293a21.ja: 第二部は、隣の会場に場所を移して「Extlink AWARD」の開催です。
2d605116cdcce253c032bdb76151de00e5293a21.en: For Part 2, the venue shifted to an adjacent room for the "Extlink AWARD."

469e0ea42587988942121cdfc9643bbc82e61f98.ja: 勝利チームはみんなで喜びを共有します。
469e0ea42587988942121cdfc9643bbc82e61f98.en: The winning team shares its joy together.

1126a840d243481fa054c3f29f1151b337f14765.ja: 「華のステージ」が決着したあとは、部署ごとで競う「出し物大会」。
1126a840d243481fa054c3f29f1151b337f14765.en: After the conclusion of the “Stage of Splendor,” each department competes in a “Performance Contest.”

aec1cf6976c04dfcf8907990a4963c8177579418.ja: コスプレに歌、スケ番に扮して上司をディスる芸など、舞台上はまさにキャラの大渋滞。
aec1cf6976c04dfcf8907990a4963c8177579418.en: The stage features everything from cosplay and singing to skit performances that lampoon supervisors, creating a bustling parade of characters.

ab941d8c24cee967ec2bbe98f10759f42323e159.ja: イメージと異なる意外な一面を呈する社員にドギマギしたり、プロ顔負けの大胆な演出に大笑いしたり、

7992a8fb7c08334db27459c0f34a18b3b1ecec16.ja: 年間MVPの受賞は、エクストリンク様社内では名誉なことで、受賞者には温かい拍手が送られるとともに、次回は私が受賞するぞ！という雰囲気が、ひしひしと伝わりました。
7992a8fb7c08334db27459c0f34a18b3b1ecec16.en: Winning the MVP of the Year is an honor within Extlink, and while the winner received warm applause, the strong feeling that "I will be the one to win next time!" was palpable among the attendees.

74f0ce440f4326a3362c43ae16b5a73a758e2f9a.ja: 「Extlink AWARD」最大の笑顔には、会場からあふれんばかりの拍手が送られました。
74f0ce440f4326a3362c43ae16b5a73a758e2f9a.en: The biggest smile of the "Extlink AWARD" was met with overwhelming applause from the venue.

3a9f490aba0dbaf3e974d9b646e95588163b06b3.ja: 最後に、参加者全員での写真撮影を行い、今期の活躍を全員で誓われました。
3a9f490aba0dbaf3e974d9b646e95588163b06b3.en: Finally, a group photo was taken with all participants, and everyone pledged their active contributions for the current fiscal year.

607c8b9cba75319f3051136a72eeebf0c293682f.ja: 最後の第三部は「決起会」です！いわゆる懇親会です。
607c8b9cba75319f3051136a72eeebf0c293682f.en: The final third part is the "Inspirational Rally"! This is a social gathering.

455c947617c690c4880d228fffbe8c2a0f327a74.ja: お取引先会社の社長様から乾杯用のシャンパンがサプライズで提供され、社長はもちろん、参加者から、感謝の拍手が会場を包み込みました。
455c947617c690c4880d228fffbe8c2a0f327a74.en: Champagne for a toast was surprisingly provided by the president of a client company, and the venue was enveloped in grateful applause from both the president and the participants.

62edc4e80a31cdb24cee63ea4548a1ee4f7cd000.ja: 法人事業統括本部執行役員　石岡様の乾杯のご発声で、決起会はスタート！
62edc4e80a31cdb24cee63ea4548a1ee4f7cd000.en: The Inspirational Rally started with a toast led by Mr. Ishioka, Executive Officer of the Corporate Business Headquarters!

ceeaef09bad510734ba64fc5e1b33308267f5ecb.ja: 16のテーブルに分かれた参加者の皆さんは、和やかに歓談され、前期の活躍をたたえ合っておられます。
ceeaef09bad510734ba64fc5e1b33308267f5ecb.en: Participants, divided into 16 tables, chatted amicably, praising each other's achievements from the previous term.

8b83395b639dd39d6b0a0c30fb4a0e338c445326.ja: 社長や重役の方々も、各テーブルを積極的に回っておられました。
8b83395b639dd39d6b0a0c30fb4a0e338c445326.en: The president and executives were also actively visiting each table.

eb7fd88fcbd6ebbc5127a9621ef05b958200f021.ja: 写真を撮る人、動画を撮る人、雄たけびを上げる人、参加者のテンションの高さを感じます。
eb7fd88fcbd6ebbc5127a9621ef05b958200f021.en: People taking photos, people recording videos, people shouting in excitement – you could feel the high energy of the participants.

672f4861c03db37a1472bf3277be1642d390e289.ja: そんな中、決起会では参加者同士の絆を深め、今期の飛躍に役立つ余興が用意されていました。
672f4861c03db37a1472bf3277be1642d390e289.en: Amidst this, the Inspirational Rally featured entertainment designed to deepen bonds among participants and contribute to this term's leap forward.

021f49893d94df803bec857ae0a387e8a68ed5e3.ja: 1つ目は「格付けチェック」です。テレビ番組でおなじみ、2択の中で本物を選ぶクイズ形式の余興です。
021f49893d94df803bec857ae0a387e8a68ed5e3.en: The first event was the "Ranking Check". This is a quiz-style entertainment, familiar from TV shows, where participants choose the genuine item from two options.

a95babd82d058278b441ddafcb3f3b76bd109af9.ja: 常識チェック、味覚チェック、センスチェックなど、全10問出題されました。
a95babd82d058278b441ddafcb3f3b76bd109af9.en: A total of 10 questions were presented, covering common sense checks, taste tests, sense checks, and more.

a99572bc982cd2815cb431062ea28c54643cfb92.ja: チーム対抗戦で、罰ゲームあり！優勝賞品あり！ということもあって、会場は大盛り上がり！
a99572bc982cd2815cb431062ea28c54643cfb92.en: It was a team competition, with penalty games and prizes for the winners! Consequently, the venue was in a huge uproar!

c9aaeb3b5d1eb2a237259d7e98d811538701bb58.ja: 2チームが同率1位で優勝！じゃんけんで最優秀チームが決定され、最優秀チームには社長から、優勝賞品「南魚沼産こしひかり」が贈られました。
c9aaeb3b5d1eb2a237259d7e98d811538701bb58.en: Two teams tied for first place and won! The best team was decided by rock-paper-scissors, and the president presented the winning team with the prize: "Minamiuonuma-produced Koshihikari rice".

d47b9e022270bbcec5ed77b2141713a0fbf6b883.ja: 2つ目の余興は「綱引き王決定戦」です！
d47b9e022270bbcec5ed77b2141713a0fbf6b883.en: The second entertainment was the "Tug-of-War King Deciding Battle"!

ba523ff0cc94cf80045b2b475502458f37d5f897.ja: 闘争心をあおるようなWe will rock youに合わせて、代表チーム6チームがプラカードを先頭に入場。
ba523ff0cc94cf80045b2b475502458f37d5f897.en: Accompanied by "We Will Rock You," which stirred up fighting spirit, six representative teams entered the venue with placards leading the way.

e2b0da3b99f86ce841f1bcbe6d3fc9561e529018.ja: トーナメント式による綱引きは、このイベントで最大の盛り上がりを見せました。
e2b0da3b99f86ce841f1bcbe6d3fc9561e529018.en: The tournament-style tug-of-war saw the biggest excitement of this event.

b18c3144901fe764be7e4ea39ff01e3203f0f24a.ja: 各チームとも団結がすごいです！
b18c3144901fe764be7e4ea39ff01e3203f0f24a.en: The unity of each team was incredible!

8844ce2ae09f6b4ae841d98f6b14921cdd65e954.ja: とにかく熱気がすごい！腕まくりして、汗をかいて、仲間と勝ち取る勝利は、何にも代えがたいものでしょう。
8844ce2ae09f6b4ae841d98f6b14921cdd65e954.en: The passion was simply overwhelming! Rolling up sleeves, sweating, and winning victory with teammates – it must be an irreplaceable experience.

ff18384176ace7f106ca81d45aa403214a138cde.ja: 優勝チームには、カルビ焼き肉が贈られました。団結して勝ち取った、カルビ焼き肉は美味しいでしょうね！
ff18384176ace7f106ca81d45aa403214a138cde.en: The winning team was awarded kalbi grilled meat. The kalbi grilled meat, won through unity, must have been delicious!

5689c1e3817d11f705b46ecd9bf5c6b983cc1519.ja: 優勝チームは、さらに役員チーム「スーパーエクストリンクマンゴッドチーム」と対戦します。
5689c1e3817d11f705b46ecd9bf5c6b983cc1519.en: The winning team then faced off against the executive team, the "Super Extlink Man God Team".

8e1c87ed3e841995c5b1657de80a015a5958144e.ja: スーパーエクストリンクマンゴッドチームと戦った優勝者チーム、なんと、優勝者チームが勝利をおさめます！
8e1c87ed3e841995c5b1657de80a015a5958144e.en: The winning team that fought the Super Extlink Man God Team... surprisingly, the winning team emerged victorious!

31ecfdd7e14ac5b18f3d2eebde6eaebbcaa85f33.ja: そして、社長から追加のプレゼントが贈られました
31ecfdd7e14ac5b18f3d2eebde6eaebbcaa85f33.en: Then, an additional gift was presented by the president.

667a369c3b604304f91b5f93f229ad7c440b524e.ja: 綱引きでボルテージが最高潮になった中、各部門の責任者による「決意表明」が行われました。
667a369c3b604304f91b5f93f229ad7c440b524e.en: With adrenaline at its peak from the tug-of-war, each department head made a "Statement of Resolve".

c21d74c3e54614deaf7bd8fa108ff3179655acbd.ja: どの責任者の方も、熱い思いを言葉に変えてスピーチされていたのが印象的です。
c21d74c3e54614deaf7bd8fa108ff3179655acbd.en: It was impressive how each manager put their passionate feelings into words during their speeches.

fe990f56d339fe5c838bcdcfd5854d0a3d2b74a5.ja: イベントは、廣瀬社長からのご挨拶での締めくくられます。
fe990f56d339fe5c838bcdcfd5854d0a3d2b74a5.en: The event was concluded with a greeting from President Hirose.

7a8434d75feb0ab3cd9bf53fca65b0fc6c4bdd41.ja: 熱い思いが溢れる社長のスピーチに、参加者が聞き入っていて、今期の活躍を誓っているようでした。
7a8434d75feb0ab3cd9bf53fca65b0fc6c4bdd41.en: The participants were captivated by the president's heartfelt speech, seeming to pledge their active contributions for the current term.

4c325c7b24d55f36acf251ff592295a1e00353a8.ja: 全5時間のイベントは盛大に終了し、出席者のみなさんは、新たな決意を胸に会場を後にしておられました。
4c325c7b24d55f36acf251ff592295a1e00353a8.en: The event, lasting 5 hours in total, concluded grandly, and the attendees left the venue with renewed determination.

761edc06071e68c3a1610e9188697e394200a11b.ja: 【イベント制作実績】2019年5月11日　Rise UP様社内イベント | 社内イベント・クリエイティブ制作のオージャスト
761edc06071e68c3a1610e9188697e394200a11b.en: [Event Production Case Study] May 11, 2019 | Internal Event for Rise UP | Orgiast Co., Ltd. – Internal Event & Creative Production

2204eee3ca978cffdad0a7ce7c6054ccd0a520ce.ja: ◆クライアント：株式会社Rise UP

a493a62069a8122fd103f916314d1fae5c8dae89.ja: ◆会場： ホテルモントレ グラスミア大阪

a7f74a186c838df1ccf355b7c1800829e3ece685.en: ◆ Event Name: Rise UP MVP AWARD 2019

e8e0dee9f77bf13ba592c0ff989bd9521dcfa1d6.ja: ◆実施内容：総会／基調講演／懇親会
e8e0dee9f77bf13ba592c0ff989bd9521dcfa1d6.en: ◆ Content: General Meeting / Keynote Speech / Social Gathering

9c886895446b39d1034b7f67b4aa4e1b609ad597.ja: 5月11日土曜日に開催された、株式会社Rise UP様の社内イベント＜Rise UP MVP AWARD 2019＞。会場はJR難波駅に直結しアクセス至便なホテルモントレ　グラスミア大阪。こうした晴れやかなイベントごとのサポートに慣れたホテルスタッフの心強い協力を得て、私たちオージャストが用意した今回の企画・演出も大成功を収めることができました。その一部始終をリポートします！
9c886895446b39d1034b7f67b4aa4e1b609ad597.en: The internal event for Rise UP Co., Ltd., <Rise UP MVP AWARD 2019>, was held on Saturday, May 11th. The venue was Hotel Monterey Grasmere Osaka, directly connected to JR Namba Station for excellent access. With the reassuring cooperation of hotel staff accustomed to supporting such celebratory events, the planning and production we, Orgiast, prepared were also a great success. We report on the entire event!

b7ad3802def7a4c01cd371f8d4faaf3aae0500b3.ja: 13:30の開場に向けて、オージャストをはじめとする裏方スタッフは進行スケジュールやその内容、スクリーンに映し出す映像や音響、照明、スタッフ配置などを入念にチェック。会場には本日のイベント成功を願うスタッフの熱い気持ちでいっぱい。開場時刻を迎えると、「ALL OUT」「People First」「Delight More」のいずれかのメッセージ（Value）が描かれたTシャツを思い思いに着こなしたRise UP従業員の皆様が、颯爽と入場されました。緊張感から一転、和やかなムードへと変化しました。
b7ad3802def7a4c01cd371f8d4faaf3aae0500b3.en: Ahead of the 13:30 opening, behind-the-scenes staff, including Orgiast, meticulously checked the schedule, content, video and audio to be displayed on screens, lighting, and staff placement. The venue was filled with the staff's heartfelt wishes for the event's success. When the opening time arrived, Rise UP employees, stylishly wearing T-shirts emblazoned with one of the messages (Values) – "ALL OUT," "People First," or "Delight More" – entered the venue briskly. The atmosphere shifted from tension to a warm, friendly mood.

0a7284be12c2a1473addbd3a6d5bb8455a74a186.ja: 照明が一瞬落ち、スクリーンに浮かび上がる「OUR VISION」の文字。それまでテーブルごとに談笑していた会場は静まり返り、視線も心も、一気につかむことができました。Tシャツに描かれていた3つのコンセプトメッセージも映し出されます。会場の心が一つになったところで、明るく元気なナレーターの声が響き、本イベントが開会したことを高らかに宣言。最高財務責任者が登壇し、乾杯の音頭へと誘います。「表彰はそれぞれの『挑戦』の1つの結果。このあと表彰される人はもちろん、そうでない人もともに喜び合い、みんなに楽しんでほしい。そして来年は自分も、と思っていただきたい。その結果、一人ひとりも、Rise UPももっと前に前にと進んでいけると思っています」と語られたのが印象的でした。
0a7284be12c2a1473addbd3a6d5bb8455a74a186.en: The lights momentarily dimmed, and the words "OUR VISION" appeared on the screen. The venue, which had been abuzz with table-side chatter, fell silent, capturing everyone's attention and hearts at once. The three concept messages printed on the T-shirts were also displayed. As the hearts of the attendees united, the cheerful voice of the announcer rang out, grandly declaring the event open. The Chief Financial Officer took the stage, inviting everyone to a toast. "The awards are one result of each person's 'challenge.' I want everyone, not just those being awarded later, but also those who are not, to share in the joy and have fun. And I hope you will think, 'I want to be up there too next year.' As a result, I believe each individual, and Rise UP as a whole, can move forward and advance," they said, which was impressive.

85e9d957961ac783f940ab92b32441b0dda8eaff.ja: 乾杯の後は15分の歓談タイムを経て、表彰式がスタート。今年は「New Face賞」「Best Team賞」など従来の8つの賞に加えて、新たに2つの賞「Challenge賞」「Improvement賞」が加わりました。プレゼンターとして社長が登壇し、合計10部門での表彰が行われました。「誰が（どのチームが）表彰されるんだろう・・・」。期待と不安の入り混じる中、ご自身や仲間の名前が発表されると、「きゃー！」「すごいやん！」悲鳴にも似た歓声があちこちで上がり、どよめく会場。受賞者には社長からの一言と表彰状、金一封が送られ、受賞コメントが求められます。受賞者が発するコメントの中には会場の笑いを呼び起こすものや、様々な壁を乗り越えての成功談、あるいは周囲への感謝を語り、感極まって涙ぐむ場面も多々見受けられ、笑いあり涙ありの感動の授賞式となりました。
85e9d957961ac783f940ab92b32441b0dda8eaff.en: After the toast and a 15-minute social break, the awards ceremony began. This year, in addition to the traditional 8 awards such as "New Face Award" and "Best Team Award," two new awards, "Challenge Award" and "Improvement Award," were added. The president took the stage as presenter, and awards were presented across a total of 10 categories. "Who (which team) will be awarded...?" Amidst the mix of anticipation and anxiety, when their own names or the names of colleagues were announced, excited screams of "Kyaa!" and "Amazing!" erupted everywhere, causing a stir in the venue. Winners received a personal comment from the president, a certificate of commendation, and a monetary award, and were asked to give an acceptance comment. The recipients' comments elicited laughter from the audience, included stories of overcoming various obstacles, or expressed gratitude to those around them, with many scenes of people becoming emotional and teary-eyed. It was a moving awards ceremony filled with both laughter and tears.

a66d452a4294da7b7a95fbd3af7367aab95297a0.ja: Rise UPに入社してよかった、良いチーム、仲間に恵まれてよかった。そんなムードが漂う中、待ちに待った余興の時間。企画者である内定者2名が進行役を買い、『Valueで語れ！Rise UP 2019 Photo Contest』がスタート！　ここで言う「Value」とはお揃いのTシャツにも刻まれた「ALL OUT」「People First」「Delight More」のこと。チームごとにいずれかのValueを体現するポーズで写真を撮り、順位を競うもの。限られた時間内でポーズ考案、撮影となりましたが、どのチームもチームワークが抜群。口々にアイデアを出してはみんなで実行し、コミュニケーション力、組織力の高さを示しました。社長曰く「最もRise UPらしさが表れていた」チームが見事1位に輝きました！
a66d452a4294da7b7a95fbd3af7367aab95297a0.en: "I'm glad I joined Rise UP," "I'm grateful for my great team and colleagues." With such an atmosphere prevailing, it was finally time for the long-awaited entertainment. Two prospective employees who planned the event took on the role of MCs, and the "Speak with Value! Rise UP 2019 Photo Contest" began! The "Values" mentioned here are "ALL OUT," "People First," and "Delight More," which were also inscribed on the matching T-shirts. Teams were required to pose in a way that embodied one of the Values and compete for ranking. Although the time for devising poses and taking photos was limited, every team demonstrated outstanding teamwork. They threw out ideas, implemented them together, and showed high communication and organizational skills. According to the president, the team that "most embodied the Rise UP spirit" took first place!

884f8289de1f932250a60ee90d335a8aa788f093.ja: 楽しい時間は、あっという間に過ぎてゆくもの。気づけば3時間が経過し、最後は専務が登壇して閉会の挨拶と一本締め。「受賞者だけではなく、参加した人すべてが楽しみ、それぞれが次年度への成長を誓い合う記念すべき1日にしたい」と言う目標は達成できたのではないでしょうか。このような素晴らしいイベントのお手伝いができて、私たちオージャストメンバーも大満足です！
884f8289de1f932250a60ee90d335a8aa788f093.en: Time flies when you're having fun. Before we knew it, 3 hours had passed, and finally, the Managing Director took the stage for closing remarks and a ceremonial handclap. Wasn't the goal of making this "a memorable day where not only the winners but all participants had fun and pledged mutual growth for the next fiscal year" achieved? Being able to assist with such a wonderful event left us, the Orgiast members, extremely satisfied!

f01824a8306f8cf2188ce972d6850827b5aee7d7.ja: 【イベント制作実績】株式会社ひかり工芸様　創業50周年記念ゴルフコンペサポート | 社内イベント・クリエイティブ制作のオージャスト
f01824a8306f8cf2188ce972d6850827b5aee7d7.en: [Event Production Case Study] Support for Golf Competition Commemorating the 50th Anniversary of Hikari Kog ei Co., Ltd. | Orgiast Co., Ltd. – Internal Event & Creative Production

f052e54601402b00c0060a91712006f467844216.ja: ◆ クライアント：株式会社ひかり工芸様

635ca0bf0b5eca8da1f94e0f089fc83fbd87486f.ja: ◆ 会場：明智ゴルフ倶楽部　明智ゴルフ場
635ca0bf0b5eca8da1f94e0f089fc83fbd87486f.en: ◆ Venue: Akechi Golf Club, Akechi Golf Course

de0369ca4714905b72188c99a94812673acf8049.ja: ◆ 実施内容：進行運営一式、表彰式の実施運営、コンペの景品手配、スケジュール・各種物品の手配／スタッフ派遣
de0369ca4714905b72188c99a94812673acf8049.en: ◆ Content: Overall operation management, awards ceremony operation, procurement of competition prizes, scheduling and procurement of various items / Staff dispatch

b69bdc6aadc6edec84b5ef0de1e0834517116da3.ja: 株式会社ひかり工芸の設立記念ゴルフコンペのお手伝いをさせていただきました。
b69bdc6aadc6edec84b5ef0de1e0834517116da3.en: We provided support for the anniversary golf competition of Hikari Kogei Co., Ltd.

6307ddc0ce98e16bd20e49a56d5ffb1a7c9e498b.ja: 開場は明智ゴルフ倶楽部　明智ゴルフ場とそのレストランを利用いたしました。
6307ddc0ce98e16bd20e49a56d5ffb1a7c9e498b.en: The venue used was Akechi Golf Club and its restaurant.

720c827314322e9d0f39c038f7c7cd2818278bf3.ja: 当日は天候もよく、AM７：００より、参加者約220名が各チームに分かれ東・中・西の各コースをまわりました。
720c827314322e9d0f39c038f7c7cd2818278bf3.en: The weather was good on the day, and from 7:00 AM, approximately 220 participants divided into teams played the East, Middle, and West courses.

ec415ad9fdd13e9e368a604406d53b1f10d36ffd.ja: その後１４：３０よりゴルフ場内のレストランにてゴルフ場のレストランにて表彰式を執り行いました。
ec415ad9fdd13e9e368a604406d53b1f10d36ffd.en: Subsequently, from 2:30 PM, the awards ceremony was held at the golf course's restaurant.

70900a5f05730c8f42aede18ba3f334ac3c3641b.ja: 代表取締役社長　倉地太様からの開会のあいさつの後乾杯を行いその後、順位発表、表彰式が行われました。
70900a5f05730c8f42aede18ba3f334ac3c3641b.en: After an opening address by Representative Director & President Futoshi Kurachi (倉地太), a toast was made, followed by the announcement of rankings and the awards ceremony.

b03c9b04e2943ec3a77fa5ff314cbf38f0f1a2ba.ja: 景品には様々な商品があり、順位発表の際、会場内は大盛り上がりを見せました。
b03c9b04e2943ec3a77fa5ff314cbf38f0f1a2ba.en: A variety of items were available as prizes, and the venue was in great excitement during the ranking announcements.

It was a great honor to support such a wonderful project. Thank you very much.

70465cea182c656c19283d27a177edcb2598a02b.ja: ウェスティンホテルにて社員総会が行われました。
70465cea182c656c19283d27a177edcb2598a02b.en: The general meeting of employees was held at The Westin Tokyo.

9df46006e34e8e155236f3ead6c8132d55b09ce6.ja: ブッフェですが、お席にてゆっくり歓談しながらお楽しみ頂きました。
9df46006e34e8e155236f3ead6c8132d55b09ce6.en: It was a buffet style, but guests enjoyed a relaxed conversation at their seats.

ddb1f6c2bb8bb02f4ac2f5fefc018470e991ec99.ja: 来年度入社する新人の内定式も行われました。フレッシュです！
ddb1f6c2bb8bb02f4ac2f5fefc018470e991ec99.en: The offer acceptance ceremony for new employees joining next fiscal year was also held. They were so fresh!

e0386b62c09a44ccb5cad6bd69949a0cf3d41a21.ja: 年間の成績優秀者の表彰式も行われました。
e0386b62c09a44ccb5cad6bd69949a0cf3d41a21.en: The awards ceremony for the year's top performers was also held.

62ad17e642dbeff646facc2066ac76b3116ef373.ja: みなさん、おめでとうございます！

d73cc31342cf92c1a2f4f51dc8c90a3a10c34275.ja: 余興はクイズ大会です。会社の歴史に絡めた問題を出題しました。
d73cc31342cf92c1a2f4f51dc8c90a3a10c34275.en: The entertainment was a quiz competition. We asked questions related to the company's history.

78a4fd970b7ad3a3cbc1f158dbb41a8811655964.ja: テーブルごとに正解を競い、会場は大盛り上がり！
78a4fd970b7ad3a3cbc1f158dbb41a8811655964.en: Each table competed for the correct answers, and the venue was a huge success!

205f7cb07eb861cbc8ef9ea359e10705b5440900.ja: 創立１０周年ということもあり、社員さんが社長さんへのサプライズ演出を考えてくれました。日頃影ながら支えてくれている奥様の言葉に、会場中が温かい雰囲気に包まれました。
205f7cb07eb861cbc8ef9ea359e10705b5440900.en: As it was the 10th anniversary of the founding, the employees organized a surprise performance for the President. The venue was filled with a warm atmosphere at the words of his wife, who has been quietly supporting him from behind.

e5b07b166fe084503c5f49b7ee6a20924f64eb2a.ja: 最後は円陣を組んで一本締めです！
e5b07b166fe084503c5f49b7ee6a20924f64eb2a.en: At the end, everyone formed a circle and did a single clap (ippon-jime)!

3129290ffdd95da4c8a2adf8d29062a7d2a4b52f.ja: 今回は会社の設立１０周年記念ということもあり、普通の社員総会ではなく、思い出に残るような社員総会になるように心がけました。社長さんへのサプライズ演出など、社長さんへの愛が感じられこちらも気持ちがほっこりしてしまいました。笑いあり！団結力あり！涙あり！で、最後は笑顔の素敵な会になったと思います。
3129290ffdd95da4c8a2adf8d29062a7d2a4b52f.en: Since this was the company's 10th anniversary, I aimed to make it a memorable general meeting of employees, not an ordinary one. The surprise for the President showed the affection for him, and it warmed our hearts as well. There was laughter! There was unity! There were tears! I believe it became a wonderful meeting with smiles at the end.

9040ab74e760eb891b553e0035e99cd97995680b.en: ◆ Venue: Dezikyu BBQ Garden SHIMBASHI BBP

0905ed61192a237d7a25bb048e57a131d30656fc.ja: 創立２０周年「例年とは違った会にしたい！」という事で、バーベキューを行うことになりました。オリジナル看板で気分も盛り上がります！
0905ed61192a237d7a25bb048e57a131d30656fc.en: For the 20th anniversary, with the request 'We want it to be different from usual!', a BBQ was held. The original signboard got everyone in the mood!

6f4192736e47235e6c1c1d16c307bb7aac825877.ja: 会場はなんと都会のど真ん中「新橋」です。都会のジャングルの中で行うバーベキューもまた格別です。
6f4192736e47235e6c1c1d16c307bb7aac825877.en: The venue was, surprisingly, right in the middle of the city: Shimbashi. A BBQ in the urban jungle was something special.

ac9ee6e17463286b70584c5429503c4472bcd43c.ja: 外なので開放感抜群！共同作業ということもあり、自然と会話も弾みます。
ac9ee6e17463286b70584c5429503c4472bcd43c.en: Being outdoors, there was a great sense of openness! As it was a collaborative activity, conversation naturally flowed.

e7aca54571267fdd8ecf39469d50dd65d3b7d625.ja: 余興でクイズを行いました。みなさん、真剣です。
e7aca54571267fdd8ecf39469d50dd65d3b7d625.en: A quiz was held as entertainment. Everyone was serious.

11172d9950990200610631fbc0224467d5ce4993.ja: それもそのはず、正解者の商品はなんと“A５ランクの牛肉”と“高級まつたけ”の食材！本当に美味しそうでした。
11172d9950990200610631fbc0224467d5ce4993.en: And for good reason: the prizes for the winners were 'A5 rank beef' and 'luxury matsutake mushrooms'! They looked truly delicious.

82dd53b8df74b9c8aeaa30546c7af42237cfa578.ja: そして某番組の「格付けチェック」も行われました。これが意外に難しい！
82dd53b8df74b9c8aeaa30546c7af42237cfa578.en: Then, a 'Rank Check' segment, like on a certain TV show, was also held. This was surprisingly difficult!

cdb1f4e53cd9ad998f073b1431bd97d1b551f8c8.ja: テレビで見るのと実際にやるのとでは全然違ったらしく、みなさん真剣に悩まれていました。
cdb1f4e53cd9ad998f073b1431bd97d1b551f8c8.en: Watching it on TV and actually doing it were apparently completely different, and everyone was earnestly pondering.

d2034ba8e90e9140f920b30403c79a930a8b5b69.ja: 格付けゲームの上位２チームによる決定戦は、なんとスイカ割り！どこかノスタルジーを感じさせるゲームに、会場は大盛り上がりでした。
d2034ba8e90e9140f920b30403c79a930a8b5b69.en: The final match between the top two teams of the rank check game was, surprisingly, a watermelon splitting game! The venue roared with excitement over this game that felt somewhat nostalgic.

37da981545414702a2396271fd2a7f2cdcb9626d.ja: 日もどっぷり暮れ、最後は三本締めです。
37da981545414702a2396271fd2a7f2cdcb9626d.en: The sun had set completely, and at the end, we did a three-part clap (sanbon-jime).

0ac9070d6114258b164c315e2cbbcdaf5ec62c89.ja: 都会のど真ん中で行ったBBQ。普段と全く違った雰囲気で会話も弾み、和やかでとっても楽しい会になりました。余興もクイズ、格付けチェック、ロシアンつくね、スイカ割りなど盛りだくさんで、会場はいつも笑いに包まれていました。
0ac9070d6114258b164c315e2cbbcdaf5ec62c89.en: The BBQ held in the middle of the city. Conversation flowed in an atmosphere completely different from usual, and it became a relaxed and very enjoyable event. With plenty of entertainment including quizzes, a rank check, Russian tsukune (meatball roulette), and watermelon splitting, the venue was constantly filled with laughter.
